   85          for i, group in enumerate(cache):
   86              check()

   88                  e0 = cache_scores[i] - memory.references[group.uid]
   89                  errors.append({"uid": group.uid, "D0": float(np.mean(e0.astype(np.float64)**2)),
   90                                 "D1": None, "residual_cross_mean": None, "residual_difference_mse": None})
   91              elif arm in ("C_cf", "C_perm"):
   92                  from step28_crossfit_retention import floor_loss
   93                  # The saved score is the actual FP32 A0 pooling result. No extra forward.
   94                  _, details = floor_loss(torch.from_numpy(cache_scores[i]), group, memory.tables[group.uid])
   95                  errors.append({"uid": group.uid, **details})
   96              else:
   97                  live = record.reference(model, group, c, check)
   98                  target = memory.tables[group.uid]
   99                  seeds = (None, data.seed_for(20261008, order, stage, group.uid, "diagnostic_regroup"))
  100                  residual = []
  101                  for seed in seeds:
  102                      slots = record.assignment(group, seed)
  103                      # Eval-only CPU pooling of the same FP32 tables; no model gradient.
  104                      view = "A0" if seed is None else "A1"
  105                      live_score = pool(torch.from_numpy(live), slots, group, view) if pooling_fn else pool(torch.from_numpy(live), slots)
  106                      teacher_score = pool(torch.from_numpy(target), slots, group, "teacher_"+view) if pooling_fn else pool(torch.from_numpy(target), slots)
  107                      residual.append((live_score-teacher_score).numpy().astype(np.float64))
  108                  e0, e1 = residual
  109                  errors.append({"uid": group.uid, "D0": float(np.mean(e0**2)), "D1": float(np.mean(e1**2)),
  110                                 "residual_cross_mean": float(np.mean(e0*e1)),
  111                                 "residual_difference_mse": float(np.mean((e1-e0)**2))})
  112                  if table_diagnostic is not None:
  113                      errors[-1].update(table_diagnostic(live, group, target))
  114      if (parent.adam_step(optimizer) != step_before

  132  def summary(values: np.ndarray, draws: np.ndarray) -> dict:
  133      estimates = values[draws].mean(axis=1)
  134      return {"mean": values.mean(axis=0).tolist(),
  135              "conditional_95pct_interval": np.quantile(estimates, [.025, .975], axis=0).T.tolist()}
  136  
  137  
  138  def curve_comparison(train: np.ndarray, valid: np.ndarray, seed: int) -> dict:
  139      """Six epochs x actual groups x three metrics; independent train/valid groups."""
  140      if train.shape[0] != 6 or valid.shape[0] != 6 or train.shape[2] != 3 or valid.shape[2] != 3:
  141          raise ValueError("Complete six-point curves required")
  142      if train.shape[1] == 0:
  143          return {"status": "NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_SURVIVING_GROUPS"}
  144      rng = np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(seed))
  145      td = rng.integers(train.shape[1], size=(5000, train.shape[1]))
  146      vd = rng.integers(valid.shape[1], size=(5000, valid.shape[1]))
  147      # Positive benefit is up for MAP/R5 and down for unweighted BCE.
  148      signs = np.array([1., 1., -1.])
  149      train_change = (train[-1]-train[0])*signs
  150      valid_change = (valid[-1]-valid[0])*signs
  151      tdelta, vdelta = summary(train_change, td), summary(valid_change, vd)
  152      gap = (train.mean(1)-valid.mean(1))*signs
  153      boot_gap = (train[:, td].mean(2)-valid[:, vd].mean(2))*signs
  154      widening = boot_gap[-1]-boot_gap[0]
  155      bounds = np.quantile(widening, [.025, .975], axis=0).T
  156      decisions = []
  157      for k in range(3):
  158          point_signal = tdelta["mean"][k] > 0 and vdelta["mean"][k] < 0 and gap[-1,k] > gap[0,k]
  159          supported = tdelta["conditional_95pct_interval"][k][0] > 0 and vdelta["conditional_95pct_interval"][k][1] < 0 and bounds[k,0] > 0
  160          decisions.append("有相应迹象" if supported else "证据不足" if point_signal else "未见明确迹象")
  161      return {"status": "DESCRIPTIVE_CONDITIONAL_DEVELOPMENT_DIAGNOSIS", "columns": list(COLUMNS),
  162              "fit_or_cache_groups": train.shape[1], "valid_groups": valid.shape[1],
  163              "train_raw_curve": train.mean(1).tolist(), "valid_raw_curve": valid.mean(1).tolist(),
  164              "benefit_gap_curve": gap.tolist(), "benefit_gap_conditional_intervals": np.quantile(boot_gap, [.025,.975], axis=1).transpose(1,2,0).tolist(),
  165              "epoch1_to_6_train_benefit": tdelta, "epoch1_to_6_valid_benefit": vdelta,
  166              "epoch1_to_6_gap_widening": {"mean": (gap[-1]-gap[0]).tolist(), "conditional_95pct_interval": bounds.tolist()},
  167              "interpretation": dict(zip(COLUMNS, decisions)),
  168              "limits": "No absence proof, causal attribution, seed coverage, selection-bias correction, or early stopping."}
  169  
  170  
  171  def evaluate(root: Path, manifest: dict, labelled: list, partition: dict, out: Path, scope: str = "ABC") -> dict:
  172      """Only the caller after complete blind gates may supply newly opened valid."""
  173      if scope not in ("ABC", "AB") or len(labelled) != 20*len(scope) or [g.uid for g in labelled] != [r["group_uid"] for r in partition["development"]]:
  174          raise ValueError("Valid group order mismatch")
  175      valid_domains = [r["domain"] for r in partition["development"]]
  176      report = {"columns": list(COLUMNS), "points": {}, "group_metrics": {}}
  177      out.mkdir()
  178      for point, records in manifest["diagnostics"].items():
  179          entries = [data.read_json(data.verify(root/r["path"], r)) for r in records]
  180          if [e["epoch"] for e in entries] != list(range(1,7)):
  181              raise ValueError("Epoch coverage differs")
  182          curves = {role: [] for role in ("fit", "cache", "valid")}
  183          for entry in entries:
  184              for key in ("fit_ids", "cache_ids", "fit_domains", "cache_domains", "valid_ids"):
  185                  if entry[key] != entries[0][key]:
  186                      raise ValueError("Curve population changed within phase")
  187              for role in ("fit", "cache"):
  188                  curves[role].append(previous.array(root, entry[role], (len(entry[role+"_ids"]),3), np.float64))
  189              values = metrics(labelled, previous.array(root, entry["valid_blind"], (20*len(scope),378), np.float32))
  190              curves["valid"].append(values)
  191              report["group_metrics"][f"{point}_epoch{entry['epoch']}"] = previous.save_array(out/f"{point}_epoch{entry['epoch']}_valid_metrics.npy", values, out)
  192          curves = {k: np.stack(v) for k,v in curves.items()}
  193          entry = entries[0]
  194          result = {}
  195          for role in ("fit", "cache"):
  196              result[role] = {}
  197              domains = [entry["order"][entry["stage"]-1]] if role == "fit" else list(entry["order"][:entry["stage"]-1])
  198              for domain in domains:
  199                  selected = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(entry[role+"_domains"]) == domain)
  200                  vr = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(valid_domains) == domain)
  201                  # Exclude arm from seed: same populations across arms share draws.
  202                  result[role][domain] = curve_comparison(curves[role][:,selected], curves["valid"][:,vr],
  203                      data.seed_for(20260930, entry["order"], entry["stage"], role, domain, "diagnostics"))
  204              if not domains:
  205                  result[role] = {"status": "NOT_APPLICABLE_FIRST_STAGE"}
  206          report["points"][point] = result
  207      data.write_json(out/"overfitting.json", report)
  208      return report
